findings: Path traversal vulnerability in render_all.sh: Section IDs from durations.json are used to construct file paths (lines 24, 26) without validation. If a section ID contains '..' or '/', files could be written to arbitrary directories. Add validation to ensure section IDs contain only alphanumeric characters.

JSON injection in render_all.sh heredocs: Variables are interpolated into JSON strings (lines 67, 81) without escaping. If section IDs or other variables contain quotes or JSON metacharacters, the outcome JSON files will be malformed. Use proper JSON encoding or validate inputs to contain only safe characters.

Path traversal in render_stats.py: Section IDs from durations.json are used to construct paths (lines 123, 138) without validation. Add input validation to ensure section IDs match expected format before using in file paths.

Unsafe environment variable trust in render_stats.py: VIDEO_CONTENT_DIR environment variable (line 36) is used directly without validation or sanitization, allowing potential directory traversal if the environment is compromised. Validate that the path stays within expected boundaries.

Command injection potential in render_all.sh: Section ID variable $s is passed to blender command line (line 38). While currently quoted, add validation to ensure section IDs cannot contain shell metacharacters as defense in depth.
